answer_2.quote: Following the suggestions in Lin et al. (2020), we report CIDEr and SPICE as generated text quality metrics. We report NIST, BLEU and METEOR as they are common metrics for evaluating the quality of long text ...

answer_4.quote: We therefore select 100 output samples from the T5 baseline and our MF model in all three tasks (300 in total). For each sample pair, we ask three annotators to judge which sample is "more human-like".
